title: Small perfect coefficient lift
statement: Let R be a small commutative ring and C a derived complex of modules over ULift R with the bounded finite-projective property [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. Then C has a representative obtained by the canonical coefficient/carrier lift of a bounded finite-projective complex P of small R-modules. The support endpoints of P can be chosen ordered. The lift first applies ModuleCat.uliftFunctor R and then restricts scalars along ULift.ringEquiv : ULift R ≃+* R. No coefficient ring is changed mathematically.

source.place: Step 3: integral models and exact rationalization

proof.text: Choose a bounded finite-projective representative M. Restrict its coefficients from ULift R to R along the inverse ring equivalence. Finite generation gives smallness of every term. Take Shrink of each term and conjugate the differentials with the Shrink linear equivalences; d squared remains zero. Projectivity and finite generation transport by these equivalences. Lift the resulting complex back to ULift R: the maps up(x) mapped to the corresponding original vector form a chain isomorphism with M. Apply Q and compose with the presentation of C. Replace a by min(a,b) to obtain ordered endpoints, which also handles the zero complex.

mathlib_searches.query: A bounded perfect complex over a lifted ring has a bounded finitely generated projective representative with small module carriers
mathlib_searches.results: ModuleCat.enoughProjectives and DerivedCategory.exists_iso_Q_obj_of_isGE_of_isLE do not retain finite-projective terms under coefficient and carrier resizing. Module.Finite.small and Shrink.linearEquiv provide ingredients; no complete comparison theorem.
Module.instProjectiveShrink and Module.Projective.of_shrink transport projectivity of individual modules, not entire complexes and their coefficient lift.

Searched Mathlib ModuleCat, Module.Projective, Finiteness.Small and project Sheaf/WeilConjectures. Found Module.Finite.small, Shrink.linearEquiv, Module.Projective.of_equiv and ModuleCat.uliftFunctor, but no comparison for a bounded finite-projective complex over ULift R.

lean.statement:
theorem small_perfect_coefficient_lift (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} R))]
    (C : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} R)))
    (hC : IsPerfectRingComplex C) :
    ∃ P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ,
      (∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ P.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE b) ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Projective R (P.X i) ∧ Module.Finite R (P.X i)) ∧
      Nonempty (C ≅ Q.obj
        (((ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u} R ⋙
          ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
            (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{u + 1, u} R ≃+* R).toRingHom
          ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
